verses.geez:
ወበሣልስ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ እምዘ ፡ ወፅኡ ፡ ውሉዶ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ በዛ ፡ ዕለት ፡ መጽኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገዳም
                  ፡ ዘሲና ።
verses.translation: And in the third month of the departure of the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt, on the same day, they came into the wilderness of Sina.

translations.lxx: And in the third month of the departure of the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt, on the same day, they came into the wilderness of Sina.
translations.kjv: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
translations.ron: Iar în luna a treia de la ieşirea fiilor lui Israel din pământul Egiptului, chiar în ziua de lună plină, au ajuns în pustia Sinai.
translations.grk: Τοῦ δὲ μηνὸς τοῦ τρίτου τῆς ἐξόδου τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ, ἤλθοσαν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον τοῦ Σινά.

verses.geez: ወወፅኡ ፡ እምራፈድ ፡ ወበጽሑ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ዘሲና ፡ ወኀደሩ ፡ ህየ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ መንጸረ ፡ ደብሩ ።
verses.translation: And they departed from Raphidin, and came into the wilderness of Sina, and there Israel encamped before the mountain.

translations.lxx: And they departed from Raphidin, and came into the wilderness of Sina, and there Israel encamped before the mountain.
translations.kjv: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.
translations.ron: Plecase deci Israel de la Rafidim şi ajungând în pustia Sinai, au tăbărât acolo în pustie, în faţa muntelui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Ῥαφιδεὶν, καὶ ἤλθοσαν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον τοῦ Σινὰ, καὶ παρενέβαλεν ἐκεῖ Ἰσραὴλ κατέναντι τοῦ ὄρους.

verses.geez:
ወሙሴ ፡ ዐርገ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወጸውዖ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ እምዲበ ፡ ደብር ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡
                  በሎሙ ፡ ለቤተ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ወዜንዎሙ ፡ ለውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And Moses went up to the mount of God, and God called him out of the mountain, saying, These things shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and thou shalt report them to the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: And Moses went up to the mount of God, and God called him out of the mountain, saying, These things shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and thou shalt report them to the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;
translations.ron: Apoi s-a suit Moise în munte, la Dumnezeu; şi l-a strigat Domnul din vârful muntelui şi i-a zis: "Grăieşte casei lui Iacov şi vesteşte fiilor lui Israel aşa:
translations.grk: Καὶ Μωυσῆς ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος τοῦ Θεοῦ· καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸν ὁ Θεὸς ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους, λέγων, τάδε ἐρεῖς τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰακὼβ, καὶ ἀναγγελεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: አንትሙ ፡ ርኢክሙ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ገበርክዎሙ ፡ ለግብጽ ፡ ወነሣእኩክሙ ፡ ከመዘ ፡ ክንፈ ፡ ጕዛ ፡ ወአቅረብኩክሙ ፡ ኀቤየ ።
verses.translation: Ye have seen all that I have done to the Egyptians, and I took you up as upon eagles' wings, and I brought you near to myself.

translations.lxx: Ye have seen all that I have done to the Egyptians, and I took you up as upon eagles' wings, and I brought you near to myself.
translations.kjv: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.
translations.ron: "Aţi văzut ce am făcut Egiptenilor şi cum v-am luat pe aripi de vultur şi v-am adus la Mine.
translations.grk: Αὐτοὶ ἑωράκατε ὅσα πεποίηκα τοῖς Αἱγυπτίοις, καὶ ἀνέλαβον ὑμᾶς ὡσεὶ ἐπὶ πτερύγων ἀετῶν, καὶ προσηγαγόμην ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἐμαυτόν.

verses.geez:
ወይእዜሂ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ሰማዕክሙኒ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ ወዐቀብክሙ ፡ ትእዛዝየ ፡ ትኩኑኒ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ዘጽድቅ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡
                  ሕዝብ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዚአየ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ኵለንታሃ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.translation: And now if ye will indeed hear my voice, and keep my covenant, ye shall be to me a peculiar people above all nations; for the whole earth is mine.

translations.lxx: And now if ye will indeed hear my voice, and keep my covenant, ye shall be to me a peculiar people above all nations; for the whole earth is mine.
translations.kjv: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
translations.ron: Deci, de veţi asculta glasul Meu şi de veţi păzi legământul Meu, dintre toate neamurile Îmi veţi fi popor ales că al Meu este tot pământul;
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν ἐὰν ἀκοῇ ἀκούσητε τῆς ἐμῆς φωνῆς, καὶ φυλάξητε τὴν διαθήκην μου, ἔσεσθέ μοι λαὸς περιούσιος ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν· ἐμὴ γάρ ἐστι πᾶσα ἡ γῆ.

verses.geez:
ወአንትሙ ፡ ትኩኑኒ ፡ እለ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ እለ ፡ ትሠውዑ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዘጽድቅ ፤ ዘቃለ ፡ አይድዖሙ ፡ ለውሉደ ፡
                  እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And ye shall be to me a royal priesthood and a holy nation: these words shalt thou speak to the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: And ye shall be to me a royal priesthood and a holy nation: these words shalt thou speak to the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Îmi veţi fi împărăţie preoţească şi neam sfânt!" Acestea sunt cuvintele pe care le vei spune fiilor lui Israel".
translations.grk: Ὑμεῖς δὲ ἔσεσθέ μοι βασίλειον ἱεράτευμα καὶ ἔθνος ἅγιον· ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα ἐρεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: ወመጽአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወጸውዐ ፡ ሊቃነ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወአይድዖሙ ፡ ዘኵሎ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ዘአዘዞሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Moses came and called the elders of the people, and he set before them all these words, which God appointed them.

translations.lxx: And Moses came and called the elders of the people, and he set before them all these words, which God appointed them.
translations.kjv: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.
translations.ron: Şi venind, Moise a chemat pe bătrânii poporului şi le-a spus toate cuvintele acestea pe care le poruncise Domnul.
translations.grk: Ἦλθε δὲ Μωυσῆς, καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους τοῦ λαοῦ· καὶ παρέθηκεν αὐτοῖς πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους, οὓς συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Θεός.

verses.geez:
ወአውሥኡ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ በ፩ቃል ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአዘዘነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ንገብር ፡ ወንሰምዕ ፡ ወአዕረገ ፡
                  ሙሴ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And all the people answered with one accord, and said, All things that God has spoken, we will do and hearken to: and Moses reported these words to God.

translations.lxx: And all the people answered with one accord, and said, All things that God has spoken, we will do and hearken to: and Moses reported these words to God.
translations.kjv: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.
translations.ron: Atunci tot poporul, răspunzând într-un glas, a zis: "Toate câte a zis Domnul vom face şi vom fi ascultători!" Şi a dus Moise cuvintele poporului la Domnul.
translations.grk: Ἀπεκρίθη δὲ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁμοθυμαδὸν, καὶ εἶπαν, πάντα ὅσα εἶπεν ὁ Θεὸς, ποιήσομεν καὶ ἀκουσόμεθα· ἀνήνεγκε δὲ Μωυσῆς τοὺς λόγους τούτους πρὸς τὸν Θεόν.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ እመጽእ ፡ አነ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ በዐምደ ፡ ደመና ፡ ከመ ፡ ይስማዕ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እንዘ ፡
                  እትናገር ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ወይእመኑ ፡ በላዕሌከ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ወአይድዐ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Lo! I come to thee in a pillar of a cloud, that the people may hear me speaking to thee, and may believe thee for ever: and Moses reported the words of the people to the Lord.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Lo! I come to thee in a pillar of a cloud, that the people may hear me speaking to thee, and may believe thee for ever: and Moses reported the words of the people to the Lord.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.
translations.ron: Iar Domnul a zis către Moise: "Iată voi veni la tine în stâlp de nor des, ca să audă poporul că Eu grăiesc cu tine, şi să te creadă pururea". Iar Moise a spus Domnului cuvintele poporului.
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ παραγίνομαι πρὸς σὲ ἐν στύλῳ νεφέλης, ἵνα ἀκούσῃ ὁ λαὸς λαλοῦντός μου πρὸς σὲ, καὶ σοὶ πιστεύσωσιν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· ἀνήγγειλε δὲ Μωυσῆς τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ λαοῦ πρὸς Κύριον.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወሪደከ ፡ ኰንን ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ወያንጽሑ ፡ ርእሶሙ ፡ ዮም ፡ ወጌሠመ ፡ ወይ[ኅፅቡ]፡
                  አልባሲሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Go down and solemnly charge the people, and sanctify them to-day and to-morrow, and let them wash their garments.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Go down and solemnly charge the people, and sanctify them to-day and to-morrow, and let them wash their garments.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
translations.ron: Zis-a Domnul către Moise: "Pogoară-te de grăieşte poporului să se ţină curat astăzi şi mâine, şi să-şi spele hainele,
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, Καταβὰς διαμάρτυραι τῷ λαῷ, καὶ ἅγνισον αὐτοὺς σήμερον καὶ αὔριον, καὶ πλυνάτωσαν τὰ ἱμάτια,

verses.geez:
ወይፅንሑ ፡ ድልዋኒሆሙ ፡ ለአመ ፡ ሣልስት ፡ ዕለት ፡ እስመ ፡ አመ ፡ ሣልስት ፡ ይወርድ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዲበ ፡ ደብር
                  ፡ ዘሲና ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ ፡ ለሕዝብ ።
verses.translation: And let them be ready against the third day, for on the third day the Lord will descend upon mount Sina before all the people.

translations.lxx: And let them be ready against the third day, for on the third day the Lord will descend upon mount Sina before all the people.
translations.kjv: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
translations.ron: Ca să fie gata pentru poimâine, căci poimâine Se va pogorî Domnul înaintea ochilor a tot poporul pe Muntele Sinai.
translations.grk: καὶ ἔστωσαν ἕτοιμοι εἰς τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν τρίτην· τῇ γὰρ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ καταβήσεται Κύριος ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινὰ, ἐναντίον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወትክፍል ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ይዑድዋ ፡ ወለይትዓቀቡ ፡ ኢይዕረጉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ዘለከፎ ፡ ለደብር ፡ በሞት ፡
                  ለይሙት ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt separate the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves that ye go not up into the mountain, nor touch any part of it: every one that touches the mountain shall surely die.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt separate the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves that ye go not up into the mountain, nor touch any part of it: every one that touches the mountain shall surely die.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
translations.ron: Să-i tragi poporului hotar împrejurul muntelui şi să-i spui: Păziţi-vă de a vă sui în munte şi de a vă atinge de ceva din el, că tot cel ce se va atinge de munte va muri.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀφοριεῖς τὸν λαὸν κύκλῳ, λέγων, προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς τοῦ ἀναβῆναι εἰς τὸ ὄρος, καὶ θίγειν τι αὐτοῦ· πᾶς ὁ ἁψάμενος τοῦ ὄρους, θανάτῳ τελευτήσει.

verses.geez:
ወእደዊሆሙኒ ፡ ኢያርእዩ ፤ በእብን ፡ ለይትወገሩ ፡ ወእማእኮ ፡ በሞፀፍ ፡ ለይተወፀፉ ፤ ወለእመ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ወለእመ ፡
                  ሰብእ ፡ ኢይሕዮ ፤ እምከመ ፡ ቃለ ፡ መጥቅዕ ፡ ወደመና ፡ ኀለፈ ፡ እምደብር ፡ ይዕርጉ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ደብር ።
verses.translation: A hand shall not touch it, for every one that touches shall be stoned with stones or shot through with a dart, whether beast or whether man, it shall not live: when the voices and trumpets and cloud depart from off the mountain, they shall come up on the mountain.

translations.lxx: A hand shall not touch it, for every one that touches shall be stoned with stones or shot through with a dart, whether beast or whether man, it shall not live: when the voices and trumpets and cloud depart from off the mountain, they shall come up on the mountain.
translations.kjv: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
translations.ron: Nici cu mâna să nu se atingă de el, că va fi ucis cu pietre sau se va săgeta cu săgeata; nu va rămâne în viaţă, fie om, fie dobitoc. Iar dacă se vor îndepărta tunetele şi trâmbiţele şi norul de pe munte, se vor putea sui în munte".
translations.grk: Οὐχ ἅψεται αὐτοῦ χείρ· ἐν γὰρ λίθοις λιθοβοληθήσεται, ἢ βολίδι κατατοξευθήσεται· ἐάν τε κτῆνος ἐάν τε ἄνθρωπος, οὐ ζήσεται· ὅταν αἱ φωναὶ καὶ αἱ σάλπιγγες καὶ ἡ νεφέλη ἀπέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους, ἐκεῖνοι ἀναβήσονται ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος.

verses.geez: ወወረደ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እምዲበ ፡ ደብር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወባረኮሙ ፡ ወኀፀቡ ፡ አልባሲሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified them, and they washed their clothes.

translations.lxx: And Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified them, and they washed their clothes.
translations.kjv: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
translations.ron: Pogorându-se deci Moise din munte la popor, el a sfinţit poporul şi, spălându-şi ei hainele,
translations.grk: Κατέβη δὲ Μωυσῆς ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους πρὸς τὸν λαὸν, καὶ ἡγίασεν αὐτούς· καὶ ἔπλυναν τὰ ἱμάτια.

verses.geez: ወይቤ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ ተደለዉ ፡ ለሠሉስ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወኢትቅረቡ ፡ አንስተ ።
verses.translation: And he said to the people, Be ready: for three days come not near to a woman.

translations.lxx: And he said to the people, Be ready: for three days come not near to a woman.
translations.kjv: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
translations.ron: Le-a zis Moise: "Să fiţi gata pentru poimâine şi de femei să nu vă atingeţi!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε τῷ λαῷ, γίνεσθε ἕτοιμοι, τρεῖς ἡμέρας μὴ προσέλθητε γυναικί.

verses.geez:
ወአመ ፡ ሣልስት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ገይሰክሙ ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ ወናሁ ፡ ትሰምዑ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ወመብረቀ ፡ ወደመና ፡ ወጊሜ ፡ በደብሩ ፡
                  ለሲና ፡ ቃለ ፡ መጥቅዕ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ድምፅ ፡ ወደንገፀ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ትዕይንት ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the third day, as the morning drew nigh, there were voices and lightnings and a dark cloud on mount Sina: the voice of the trumpet sounded loud, and all the people in the camp trembled.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass on the third day, as the morning drew nigh, there were voices and lightnings and a dark cloud on mount Sina: the voice of the trumpet sounded loud, and all the people in the camp trembled.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.
translations.ron: Iar a treia zi, când s-a făcut ziuă, erau tunete şi fulgere şi nor des pe Muntele Sinai şi sunet de trâmbiţe foarte puternic. Şi s-a cutremurat tot poporul în tabără.
translations.grk: Ἐγένετο δὲ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ γενηθέντος πρὸς ὄρθρον, καὶ ἐγένοντο φωναὶ καὶ ἀστραπαὶ καὶ νεφέλη γνοφώδης ἐπʼ ὄρους Σινά· φωνὴ τῆς σάλπιγγος ἤχει μέγα· καὶ ἐπτοήθη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ.

verses.geez: ወአውፅአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ይትራከብ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ፈጣሪ ፡ እምትዕይንት ፡ ወበጽሑ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ደብር ።
verses.translation: And Moses led the people forth out of the camp to meet God, and they stood by under the mountain.

translations.lxx: And Moses led the people forth out of the camp to meet God, and they stood by under the mountain.
translations.kjv: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
translations.ron: Atunci a scos Moise poporul din tabără în întâmpinarea lui Dumnezeu şi au stat la poalele muntelui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξήγαγε Μωυσῆς τὸν λαὸν εἰς συνάντησιν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς· καὶ παρέστησαν ὑπὸ τὸ ὄρος.

verses.geez:
ወደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ ይጠይስ ፡ ኵለንታሁ ፡ እስመ ፡ ወረደ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውሰቴታ ፡ በእሳት ፡ ወይወፅእ ፡ በውስቴታ ፡
                  ከመ ፡ ጢስ ፡ ዘእምእቶን ፡ ወደንገፀ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ጥቀ ።
verses.translation: The mount of Sina was altogether on a smoke, because God had descended upon it in fire; and the smoke went up as the smoke of a furnace, and the people were exceedingly amazed.

translations.lxx: The mount of Sina was altogether on a smoke, because God had descended upon it in fire; and the smoke went up as the smoke of a furnace, and the people were exceedingly amazed.
translations.kjv: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
translations.ron: Iar Muntele Sinai fumega tot, că Se pogorâse Dumnezeu pe el în foc; şi se ridica de pe el fum, ca fumul dintr-un cuptor, şi tot muntele se cutremura puternic.
translations.grk: Τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινὰ ἐκαπνίζετο ὅλον, διὰ τὸ καταβεβηκέναι ἐπʼ αὐτὸ τὸν Θεὸν ἐν πυρί· καὶ ἀνέβαινεν ὁ καπνὸς, ὡσεὶ καπνὸς καμίνου· καὶ ἐξέστη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς σφόδρα.

verses.geez:
ወይደምፅ ፡ ድምፀ ፡ መጥቅዕ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይበልሕ ፡ ይኄይል ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ወሙሴ ፡ ይትናገር ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ያወሥኦ ፡
                  በቃሉ ።
verses.translation: And the sounds of the trumpet were waxing very much louder. Moses spoke, and God answered him with a voice.

translations.lxx: And the sounds of the trumpet were waxing very much louder. Moses spoke, and God answered him with a voice.
translations.kjv: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
translations.ron: De asemenea şi sunetul trâmbiţei se auzea din ce în ce mai tare; şi Moise grăia, iar Dumnezeu îi răspundea cu glas.
translations.grk: Ἐγίνοντο δὲ αἱ φωναὶ τῆς σάλπιγγος προβαίνουσαι ἰσχυρότεραι σφόδρα. Μωυσῆς ἐλάλησεν, ὁ δὲ Θεὸς ἀπεκρίνατο αὐτῷ φωνῇ.

verses.geez: ወወረደ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከተማሁ ፡ ለደብር ፡ ወዐርገ ፡ ሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord came down upon mount Sina on the top of the mountain; and the Lord called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

translations.lxx: And the Lord came down upon mount Sina on the top of the mountain; and the Lord called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
translations.kjv: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
translations.ron: Deci, fiind pogorât Domnul pe Muntele Sinai, pe vârful muntelui, a chemat Domnul pe Moise în vârful muntelui şi s-a suit Moise acolo.
translations.grk: Κατέβη δὲ Κύριος ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινὰ ἐπὶ τὴν κορυφὴν τοῦ ὄρους· καὶ ἐκάλεσε Κύριος Μωυσῆν ἐπὶ τὴν κορυφὴν τοῦ ὄρους· καὶ ἀνέβη Μωυσῆς.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ረድ ፡ ወአይድዖሙ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ ኢይቅረቡ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለጠይቆ ፡ ኢይደቅ
                  ፡ በውስቴቶሙ ፡ ብዙኅ ።
verses.translation: And God spoke to Moses, saying, Go down, and solemnly charge the people, lest at any time they draw nigh to God to gaze, and a multitude of them fall.

translations.lxx: And God spoke to Moses, saying, Go down, and solemnly charge the people, lest at any time they draw nigh to God to gaze, and a multitude of them fall.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
translations.ron: Atunci a zis Domnul către Moise: "Pogoară-te şi opreşte poporul, ca să nu năvălească spre Domnul, să vadă slava Lui, că vor cădea mulţi dintre ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Θεὸς πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων, καταβὰς διαμάρτυραι τῷ λαῷ, μή ποτε ἐγγίσωσι πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν κατανοῆσαι, καὶ πέσωσιν ἐξ αὐτῶν πλῆθος·

verses.geez: ወሠዋዕት ፡ እለ ፡ ይቄርቡ ፡ ለእግዚእ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይትባረኩ ፡ ኢይኅለቅ ፡ እምላዕሌሆሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And let the priests that draw nigh to the Lord God sanctify themselves, lest he destroy some of them.

translations.lxx: And let the priests that draw nigh to the Lord God sanctify themselves, lest he destroy some of them.
translations.kjv: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.
translations.ron: Iar preoţii, care se apropie de Domnul Dumnezeu, să se sfinţească, ca nu cumva să-i lovească Domnul".
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ ἐγγίζοντες Κυρίῳ τῷ Θεῷ ἁγιασθήτωσαν, μήποτε ἀπαλλάξῃ ἀπʼ αὐτῶν Κύριος.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኢይክል ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዐሪገ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ እስመ ፡ አስማዕከነ ፡ ወትቤለነ
                  ፡ ኢትልክፉ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ወትባርክዎ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to God, The people will not be able to approach to the mount of Sina, for thou hast solemnly charged us, saying, Set bounds to the mountain and sanctify it.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to God, The people will not be able to approach to the mount of Sina, for thou hast solemnly charged us, saying, Set bounds to the mountain and sanctify it.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
translations.ron: Zis-a Moise către Domnul: "Nu se poate ca poporul să se suie pe Muntele Sinai, pentru că Tu ne-ai oprit din vreme, şi ai zis: Trage hotar împrejurul muntelui şi-l sfinţeşte!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν, οὐ δυνήσεται ὁ λαὸς προσαναβῆναι πρὸς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινά· σὺ γὰρ διαμεμαρτύρησαι ἡμῖν, λέγων, ἀφόρισαι τὸ ὄρος, καὶ ἁγίασαι αὐτό.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ሑር ፡ ወረድ ፡ ወዕረግ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ ምስሌከ ፤ ወሠዋዕት[ሰ] ፡ [ወሕዝብ
                  ፡] ኢይትኀየሉ ፡ ዐሪገ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፤ ያሐጕል ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to him, Go, descend, and come up thou and Aaron with thee; but let not the priests and the people force their way to come up to God, lest the Lord destroy some of them.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to him, Go, descend, and come up thou and Aaron with thee; but let not the priests and the people force their way to come up to God, lest the Lord destroy some of them.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.
translations.ron: Iar Domnul i-a răspuns: "Du-te şi te pogoară şi apoi te vei sui împreună cu Aaron; iar preoţii şi poporul să nu îndrăznească a se sui la Domnul, ca să nu-i lovească Domnul".
translations.grk: Εἴπε δὲ αὐτῷ Κύριος, βάδιζε, κατάβηθι, καὶ ἀνάβηθι σὺ καὶ Ἀαρὼν μετὰ σοῦ· οἱ δὲ ἱερεῖς καὶ ὁ λαὸς μὴ βιαζέσθωσαν ἀναβῆναι πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν, μὴ ποτε ἀπολέσῃ ἀπʼ αὐτῶν Κύριος.

verses.geez: ወወረደ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ።
verses.translation: And Moses went down to the people, and spoke to them.

translations.lxx: And Moses went down to the people, and spoke to them.
translations.kjv: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
translations.ron: Şi s-a pogorât Moise la popor şi i-a spus toate.
translations.grk: Κατέβη δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς τὸν λαὸν, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς.
